podcast.title: Nickname Origin
podcast.body: Henry Smith earned the nickname "the Horse" due to his extraordinary strength and ability to carry massive speaker cabinets as if they were weightless, a feat that impressed those who worked with him. "Why was he called the horse? Because he could carry huge speaker cabinets like they weighed nothing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Roadie for Legendary Bands
podcast.body: Henry "the Horse" Smith was a renowned roadie who worked for several iconic bands, including The Yardbirds, Led Zeppelin, and Aerosmith, showcasing his extensive experience in the music industry. "There's Henry the horse Smith, who humped gear for the yardbirds Led Zeppelin and Error Smith."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
